title: Ivo and the Extraction
author: U. M. Marchetti
blurb: Lior Joubert, a private security contractor guarding clients nobody trusts, keeps a go-bag packed and a lie polished. Then a voiceprint unlocks a server on another continent — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, he must stop an attack scheduled to look like an accident before the markets open in Frankfurt.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
